test_m3 = '''"""Test m3: Both @cache and @memoize wrappers should expose .memory, .invalidate_all(), and support .skip."""

import pytest


def test_cache_has_memory_attribute():
    """cache wrapper should expose .memory (or equivalent) to access cached data."""
    import funcy.calc as calc
    cache = calc.cache

    @cache(60)
    def f(x):
        return x * 2

    # Should have a memory attribute that is dict-like
    assert hasattr(f, "memory")
    assert isinstance(f.memory, dict)

    # After calling, memory should contain entries
    f(5)
    assert len(f.memory) >= 1


def test_cache_has_invalidate_all():
    """cache wrapper should have .invalidate_all() to clear all cached data."""
    import funcy.calc as calc
    cache = calc.cache

    call_count = [0]

    @cache(60)
    def f(x):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return x * 2

    # Populate cache
    f(1)
    f(2)
    assert call_count[0] == 2

    # Invalidate all
    f.invalidate_all()

    # Next calls should recompute
    r1 = f(1)
    assert r1 == 2
    assert call_count[0] == 3


def test_memoize_has_invalidate():
    """memoize wrapper should have .invalidate(key) method like cache."""
    import funcy.calc as calc
    memoize = calc.memoize

    call_count = [0]

    @memoize
    def f(x):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return x * 3

    # Populate cache
    r1 = f(5)
    assert r1 == 15
    assert call_count[0] == 1

    # Should have invalidate method
    assert hasattr(f, "invalidate")
    assert callable(f.invalidate)

    # Invalidate specific key
    f.invalidate(5)

    # Next call should recompute
    r2 = f(5)
    assert r2 == 15
    assert call_count[0] == 2


def test_memoize_has_invalidate_all():
    """memoize wrapper should have .invalidate_all() to clear all cached data."""
    import funcy.calc as calc
    memoize = calc.memoize

    call_count = [0]

    @memoize
    def f(x):
        call_count[0] += 1
        return x * 3

    # Populate cache
    f(1)
    f(2)
    assert call_count[0] == 2

    # Should have invalidate_all
    assert hasattr(f, "invalidate_all")
    assert callable(f.invalidate_all)

    # Invalidate all
    f.invalidate_all()

    # Next calls should recompute
    r1 = f(1)
    assert r1 == 3
    assert call_count[0] == 3


def test_unified_skip_behavior():
    """Both cache and memoize should support .skip behavior if applicable."""
    import funcy.calc as calc
    cache = calc.cache
    memoize = calc.memoize

    # memoize should have skip
    assert hasattr(memoize, "skip")
    assert issubclass(memoize.skip, Exception)

    # cache should also expose skip behavior
    @cache(60)
    def cf(x):
        return x * 2

    assert hasattr(cf, "skip") or hasattr(cache, "skip")
'''
